captions.detailed: This 3D model features a rectangular window box fan with a light gray housing and a slide-out window frame adapter. The main housing contains a central five-blade fan propeller in a dark gray finish, mounted behind a molded wire grille. A single black cylindrical speed selector knob is positioned on the front face of the unit. The window frame adapter slides horizontally on a prismatic joint, while the fan propeller and selector knob are mounted on revolute joints.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a window box fan. The model must include a rectangular light gray main housing, a sliding window frame adapter on a prismatic joint, a central five-blade propeller behind a protective wire grille on a revolute axle, and a small black speed selector knob on a revolute joint on the front panel.
captions.factory: Create the main frame using box primitives and boolean operations to hollow out the center. Model the wire grille using thin cylindrical bars patterned horizontally and vertically. Construct the five-blade propeller by creating a central hub cylinder and arraying five angled blade solids around it. Build the slide-out window adapter using nested box extrusions, and define the prismatic joint along the horizontal axis, while the propeller and selector knob are defined with revolute joints.
